blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: IP address — Network-layer address used to route packets.
resolver — Client/service that queries DNS and caches answers.
router — Forwards IP packets towards destination networks.

blocks.title: Refresh after TTL
blocks.text: The cached address may remain until its TTL expires; client may contact an outdated endpoint. The resolver can refresh after expiry. DNS propagation and authoritative changes do not guarantee immediate worldwide consistency.
